text:
anna: Kicking off SDK v7 rollout next Tue 09:00 PT. Who can own the canary deploy + smoke checks? Need an owner for rollback too.

kyle: I can own canary + smoke. I'll need runbook + rollback commands.

jordan: I'll own client comms and changelog. Quick Q — any breaking changes we need to call out in the release notes?

anna: Two small changes: 1) we rename the rate-limit response header to `X-RW-Rate` (old `X-RW-Limit` still accepted for now with a warning), 2) we deprecate `meta.mode=legacy` param — server will accept legacy values but log a deprecation warning. Both are backward-compatible for v6 clients but we should call them out.

maya: I'll run the integration matrix against sdk-6.x tomorrow and post failures. ETA EOD.

sasha: Reminder — feature flag `accept_legacy_headers` must be on during canary. Ops can flip it off in prod after 2 weeks.

kyle: Proposed canary plan:
- 09:00 PT: deploy canary to us-west2 (10% traffic)
- 09:10: run smoke tests (below)
- 09:25: evaluate metrics, if ok ramp to 50% and run full test suite
- 10:00: full rollout if no regressions

Smoke checklist (short):
1) health checks all green
2) sdk-6 end-to-end: auth, rate-limits, streaming
3) sample production prompts through canary (latency & token delta)
4) check logs for deprecation warnings spikes
5) quick rollback smoke: run rollback command and verify main stable

Rollback command (ops):
```
# rollback to previous replicaSet
kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-api --to-revision=1234 -n redwood-prod
# or via deployctl
deployctl rollback api --to-tag v6-stable --reason "sdk7 canary issue"
```

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @anna for 2024-06-26T16:00:00Z — will post updates.

jordan: I'll draft the client note: highlight header rename + deprecation section + migration snippet for JS/Python. Will share by EOD for review.

maya: Integration run started — posting logs in a thread. Will @kyle when done.

anna: Thanks all. Kyle — can you confirm you have permissions to trigger rollback if needed? Also set an alert for error-rate >0.5% on canary.

kyle: Confirmed, I have perms and will own rollback. I'll add the alert and post the playbook link right after smoke prep. :thumbsup:
